verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς διατάσσων τοῖς δώδεκα μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ μετέβη ἐκεῖθεν τοῦ διδάσκειν καὶ κηρύσσειν ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto hote etelesen ho Iēsous diatassōn tois dōdeka mathētais autou metebē ekeithen tou didaskein kai kēryssein en tais polesin autōn
verses.literal: After . . . . . . Jesus had finished instructing His twelve disciples He went on from there to teach and preach in their cities

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰωάννης ἀκούσας ἐν τῷ δεσμωτηρίῳ τὰ ἔργα τοῦ Χριστοῦ πέμψας διὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iōannēs akousas en tō desmōtēriō ta erga tou Christou pempsas dia tōn mathētōn autou
verses.literal: Meanwhile John heard in prison about the works of Christ and he sent his disciples

verses.original: εἶπεν αὐτῷ Σὺ εἶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἢ ἕτερον προσδοκῶμεν
verses.transliteration: eipen autō Sy ei ho erchomenos ē heteron prosdokōmen
verses.literal: to ask Him Are You the One who was to come or should we look for someone else

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πορευθέντες ἀπαγγείλατε Ἰωάννῃ ἃ ἀκούετε καὶ βλέπετε
verses.transliteration: Kai apokritheis ho Iēsous eipen autois Poreuthentes apangeilate Iōannē ha akouete kai blepete
verses.literal: Jesus replied . . . . . . Go back and report to John what you hear and see

verses.original: τυφλοὶ ἀναβλέπουσιν καὶ χωλοὶ περιπατοῦσιν λεπροὶ καθαρίζονται καὶ κωφοὶ ἀκούουσιν καὶ νεκροὶ ἐγείρονται καὶ πτωχοὶ εὐαγγελίζονται
verses.transliteration: typhloi anablepousin kai chōloi peripatousin leproi katharizontai kai kōphoi akouousin kai nekroi egeirontai kai ptōchoi euangelizontai
verses.literal: The blind receive sight the lame walk the lepers are cleansed the deaf hear the dead are raised and the good news is preached to the poor

verses.original: καὶ μακάριός ἐστιν ὃς ἐὰν μὴ σκανδαλισθῇ ἐν ἐμοί
verses.transliteration: kai makarios estin hos ean mē skandalisthē en emoi
verses.literal: Blessed is the one who does not fall away . . . . . . on account of Me

verses.original: Τούτων δὲ πορευομένων ἤρξατο ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγειν τοῖς ὄχλοις περὶ Ἰωάννου Τί ἐξήλθατε εἰς τὴν ἔρημον θεάσασθαι κάλαμον ὑπὸ ἀνέμου σαλευόμενον
verses.transliteration: Toutōn de poreuomenōn ērxato ho Iēsous legein tois ochlois peri Iōannou Ti exēlthate eis tēn erēmon theasasthai kalamon hypo anemou saleuomenon
verses.literal: As John’s disciples were leaving Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John What did you go out into the wilderness to see A reed swaying in the wind

verses.original: ἀλλὰ τί ἐξήλθατε ἰδεῖν ἄνθρωπον ἐν μαλακοῖς ἠμφιεσμένον ἰδοὺ οἱ τὰ μαλακὰ φοροῦντες ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις τῶν βασιλέων εἰσίν
verses.transliteration: alla ti exēlthate idein anthrōpon en malakois ēmphiesmenon idou hoi ta malaka phorountes en tois oikois tōn basileōn eisin
verses.literal: Otherwise what did you go out to see A man dressed in fine clothes Look those who wear fine clothing are found in - kings’ palaces

verses.original: ἀλλὰ τί ἐξήλθατε προφήτην ἰδεῖν ναί λέγω ὑμῖν καὶ περισσότερον προφήτου
verses.transliteration: alla ti exēlthate prophētēn idein nai legō hymin kai perissoteron prophētou
verses.literal: What then did you go out to see A prophet Yes I tell you and more than a prophet

verses.original: οὗτός ἐστιν περὶ οὗ γέγραπται Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω τὸν ἄγγελόν μου πρὸ προσώπου σου Ὃς κατασκευάσει τὴν ὁδόν σου ἔμπροσθέν σου
verses.transliteration: houtos estin peri hou gegraptai Idou egō apostellō ton angelon mou pro prosōpou sou Hos kataskeuasei tēn hodon sou emprosthen sou
verses.literal: This is the one about whom it is written Behold I will send My messenger ahead of You . . . . . . who will prepare Your way before You

verses.original: Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν οὐκ ἐγήγερται ἐν γεννητοῖς γυναικῶν μείζων Ἰωάννου τοῦ Βαπτιστοῦ ὁ δὲ μικρότερος ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν μείζων αὐτοῦ ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Amēn legō hymin ouk egēgertai en gennētois gynaikōn meizōn Iōannou tou Baptistou ho de mikroteros en tē basileia tōn ouranōn meizōn autou estin
verses.literal: Truly I tell you among those born of women there has risen no one greater than John the Baptist Yet even the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he

verses.original: ἀπὸ δὲ τῶν ἡμερῶν Ἰωάννου τοῦ Βαπτιστοῦ ἕως ἄρτι ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν βιάζεται καὶ βιασταὶ ἁρπάζουσιν αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: apo de tōn hēmerōn Iōannou tou Baptistou heōs arti hē basileia tōn ouranōn biazetai kai biastai harpazousin autēn
verses.literal: From the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven has been subject to violence and the violent lay claim to it

verses.original: πάντες γὰρ οἱ προφῆται καὶ ὁ νόμος ἕως Ἰωάννου ἐπροφήτευσαν
verses.transliteration: pantes gar hoi prophētai kai ho nomos heōs Iōannou eprophēteusan
verses.literal: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John

verses.original: καὶ εἰ θέλετε δέξασθαι αὐτός ἐστιν Ἠλίας ὁ μέλλων ἔρχεσθαι
verses.transliteration: kai ei thelete dexasthai autos estin Ēlias ho mellōn erchesthai
verses.literal: And if you are willing to accept it he is the Elijah who was to come

verses.original: Ὁ ἔχων ὦτα ἀκουέτω
verses.transliteration: Ho echōn ōta akouetō
verses.literal: He who has ears let him hear

verses.original: Τίνι δὲ ὁμοιώσω τὴν γενεὰν ταύτην ὁμοία ἐστὶν παιδίοις καθημένοις ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς ἃ προσφωνοῦντα τοῖς ἑτέροις
verses.transliteration: Tini de homoiōsō tēn genean tautēn homoia estin paidiois kathēmenois en tais agorais ha prosphōnounta tois heterois
verses.literal: To what can I compare this generation They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others

verses.original: λέγουσιν Ηὐλήσαμεν ὑμῖν Καὶ οὐκ ὠρχήσασθε Ἐθρηνήσαμεν Καὶ οὐκ ἐκόψασθε
verses.transliteration: legousin Ēulēsamen hymin Kai ouk ōrchēsasthe Ethrēnēsamen Kai ouk ekopsasthe
verses.literal: We played the flute for you and you did not dance we sang a dirge and you did not mourn

verses.original: Ἦλθεν γὰρ Ἰωάννης μήτε ἐσθίων μήτε πίνων καὶ λέγουσιν Δαιμόνιον ἔχει
verses.transliteration: Ēlthen gar Iōannēs mēte esthiōn mēte pinōn kai legousin Daimonion echei
verses.literal: For John came neither eating nor drinking and they say He has a demon

verses.original: ἦλθεν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐσθίων καὶ πίνων καὶ λέγουσιν Ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος φάγος καὶ οἰνοπότης τελωνῶν φίλος καὶ ἁμαρτωλῶν καὶ ἐδικαιώθη ἡ σοφία ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: ēlthen ho Huios tou anthrōpou esthiōn kai pinōn kai legousin Idou anthrōpos phagos kai oinopotēs telōnōn philos kai hamartōlōn kai edikaiōthē hē sophia apo tōn ergōn autēs
verses.literal: The Son of Man came eating and drinking and they say Look at this glutton and drunkard a friend of tax collectors and sinners But wisdom is vindicated by her actions

verses.original: Τότε ἤρξατο ὀνειδίζειν τὰς πόλεις ἐν αἷς ἐγένοντο αἱ πλεῖσται δυνάμεις αὐτοῦ ὅτι οὐ μετενόησαν
verses.transliteration: Tote ērxato oneidizein tas poleis en hais egenonto hai pleistai dynameis autou hoti ou metenoēsan
verses.literal: Then Jesus began to denounce the cities in which most of His miracles had been performed because they did not repent

verses.original: Οὐαί σοι Χοραζίν οὐαί σοι Βηθσαϊδά ὅτι εἰ ἐν Τύρῳ καὶ Σιδῶνι ἐγένοντο αἱ δυνάμεις αἱ γενόμεναι ἐν ὑμῖν πάλαι ἂν ἐν σάκκῳ καὶ σποδῷ μετενόησαν
verses.transliteration: Ouai soi Chorazin ouai soi Bēthsaida hoti ei en Tyrō kai Sidōni egenonto hai dynameis hai genomenai en hymin palai an en sakkō kai spodō metenoēsan
verses.literal: Woe to you Chorazin Woe to you Bethsaida For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes

verses.original: πλὴν λέγω ὑμῖν Τύρῳ καὶ Σιδῶνι ἀνεκτότερον ἔσται ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κρίσεως ἢ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: plēn legō hymin Tyrō kai Sidōni anektoteron estai en hēmera kriseōs ē hymin
verses.literal: But I tell you it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you

verses.original: Καὶ σύ Καφαρναούμ μὴ ἕως οὐρανοῦ ὑψωθήσῃ ἕως ᾅδου καταβήσῃ ὅτι εἰ ἐν Σοδόμοις ἐγενήθησαν αἱ δυνάμεις αἱ γενόμεναι ἐν σοί ἔμεινεν ἂν μέχρι τῆς σήμερον
verses.transliteration: Kai sy Kapharnaoum mē heōs ouranou hypsōthēsē heōs hadou katabēsē hoti ei en Sodomois egenēthēsan hai dynameis hai genomenai en soi emeinen an mechri tēs sēmeron
verses.literal: And you Capernaum will you be lifted up to heaven No, you will be brought down to Hades For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom it would have remained to this day

verses.original: πλὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι γῇ Σοδόμων ἀνεκτότερον ἔσται ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κρίσεως ἢ σοί
verses.transliteration: plēn legō hymin hoti gē Sodomōn anektoteron estai en hēmera kriseōs ē soi
verses.literal: But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you

verses.original: Ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ἐξομολογοῦμαί σοι Πάτερ Κύριε τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τῆς γῆς ὅτι ἔκρυψας ταῦτα ἀπὸ σοφῶν καὶ συνετῶν καὶ ἀπεκάλυψας αὐτὰ νηπίοις
verses.transliteration: En ekeinō tō kairō apokritheis ho Iēsous eipen Exomologoumai soi Pater Kyrie tou ouranou kai tēs gēs hoti ekrypsas tauta apo sophōn kai synetōn kai apekalypsas auta nēpiois
verses.literal: At that time Jesus declared I praise You Father Lord of heaven and earth because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned and revealed them to little children

verses.original: ναί ὁ Πατήρ ὅτι οὕτως εὐδοκία ἐγένετο ἔμπροσθέν σου
verses.transliteration: nai ho Patēr hoti houtōs eudokia egeneto emprosthen sou
verses.literal: Yes Father for this was well-pleasing in Your sight . . .

verses.original: Πάντα μοι παρεδόθη ὑπὸ τοῦ Πατρός μου καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπιγινώσκει τὸν Υἱὸν εἰ μὴ ὁ Πατήρ οὐδὲ τὸν Πατέρα τις ἐπιγινώσκει εἰ μὴ ὁ Υἱὸς καὶ ᾧ ἐὰν βούληται ὁ Υἱὸς ἀποκαλύψαι
verses.transliteration: Panta moi paredothē hypo tou Patros mou kai oudeis epiginōskei ton Huion ei mē ho Patēr oude ton Patera tis epiginōskei ei mē ho Huios kai hō ean boulētai ho Huios apokalypsai
verses.literal: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father No one knows the Son except . . . the Father and no one knows the Father except . . . the Son and those to whom . . . the Son chooses to reveal Him

verses.original: Δεῦτε πρός με πάντες οἱ κοπιῶντες καὶ πεφορτισμένοι κἀγὼ ἀναπαύσω ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Deute pros me pantes hoi kopiōntes kai pephortismenoi kagō anapausō hymas
verses.literal: Come to Me all you who are weary and burdened and I will give you rest

verses.original: ἄρατε τὸν ζυγόν μου ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς καὶ μάθετε ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ ὅτι πραΰς εἰμι καὶ ταπεινὸς τῇ καρδίᾳ καὶ εὑρήσετε ἀνάπαυσιν ταῖς ψυχαῖς ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: arate ton zygon mou eph’ hymas kai mathete ap’ emou hoti praus eimi kai tapeinos tē kardia kai heurēsete anapausin tais psychais hymōn
verses.literal: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me for I am gentle and humble in heart and you will find rest for your souls

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ ζυγός μου χρηστὸς καὶ τὸ φορτίον μου ἐλαφρόν ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: ho gar zygos mou chrēstos kai to phortion mou elaphron estin
verses.literal: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light
